jobs.title: Software Deployment Engineer
jobs.desc: About KPI Solutions KPI Solutions is a national supply chain consulting and warehouse automation systems integrator, helping some of the biggest names in e-commerce, retail, and distribution move product faster and smarter. Formed in 2021 through the combination of Kuecker Logistics Group, PULSE Integration, and QC Software, KPI brings together decades of material handling and systems integration experience â rooted in material handling integration dating back to 1971. From initial design through go-live and ongoing support, KPI delivers engineered solutions that blend automated technologies (MHE, robotics, conveyor, ASRS, AMR/AGV) with intelligent warehouse execution software to optimize productivity, increase fulfillment speed, and build operational resilience for clients. Position SummaryÂ The Software Deployment Engineer I/II is an individual-contributor role responsible for the end-to-end delivery, configuration, installation, and support of Kommand warehouse execution/control systems and related material handling hardware (pick-to-light, overhead illuminators, AutoStore, and T-sort integrations). This role owns project-level system configuration, commissioning, installation, upgrade, and live troubleshooting work independently, with minimal oversight, across both on-site and remote/office phases of the project lifecycle. It combines software commissioning, hardware coordination, database scripting, environment configuration, and formal test/sign-off responsibilities that have historically been distributed across multiple roles and a dedicated installation team.Â This position carries broadened scope following the consolidation of hardware installation and commissioning functions previously performed by a dedicated Systems Integration Commissioning (SI C) team, which has since been dissolved. The Software Deployment Engineer I/II is expected to operate as the primary and, in several functions, sole point of ownership for the responsibilities outlined below.Â Key ResponsibilitiesÂ On-Site DeliveryÂ Lead software commissioning of Kommand and peripheral hardware systems at customer sites; serve as primary technical owner, with hardware-side support from junior/peer staff.Â Own full-scope installation of pick-to-light systems, including wiring, physical installation, configuration, and functional testing â a scope absorbed from the former SI C team.Â Own full-scope installation of overhead illuminator systems, following the same end-to-end responsibility as above.Â Conduct IQ (Installation Qualification) and UAT (User Acceptance Testing) following installation, including preparation of formal test documentation and customer sign-off.Â Serve as the sole owner of Kommand and system-level troubleshooting for live, in-production issues during on-site engagements.Â Remote / Office DeliveryÂ Independently deliver new Kommand installations, including application pre-configuration, database scripting, and pre-deployment testing. Sole personnel on this workstream, currently managing 4 upcoming and 1 active installation.Â Independently deliver Kommand version upgrades, including SSDT (SQL Server Data Tools) schema comparisons, version control, local pre-install testing, and direct customer coordination. Sole personnel on this workstream, with approximately 22 major upgrades planned in the current year.Â Production upgrade execution is performed after standard business hours to minimize customer downtime.Â DEV, QA, and Sandbox environment work is performed during standard business hours.Â Validate, diagnose, and remediate reported defects; route confirmed fixes to QA prior to merge and deployment. Escalation to other engineering resources is rare.Â Participate in the on-call rotation covering Kommand, AutoStore, and T-sort system escalations.Â Provide post-go-live project support on an as-needed basis, including system migrations (e.g., bin/location migrations), integration testing with customer ERP/WMS platforms (e.g., SAP/WMS), and multi-site rollout support.Â Project Configuration DeploymentÂ Gather all Kommand configurations and system parameters required for a given project.Â Translate the Business Requirements Document (BRD) and customer conversations into the Kommand system settings spreadsheet, network spreadsheet, and system parameters.Â Educate the client on use of the host interface.Â Not required for all projects â dependent on whether the customer's integration involves interface changes (e.g., AutoCase, Pack Hold).Â Configure the client's Kommand sandbox environment to be project-specific for customer testing, and support the client through that testing.Â Configure the Kommand production environment ahead of go-live.Â Assist with training on any new features requiring customer or internal education.Â Scope IndependenceÂ This role currently operates as the sole owner of several critical workstreams, including all new Kommand installations, all Kommand upgrade delivery, and all live Kommand/system troubleshooting. The role requires the judgment and technical depth to manage customer-facing delivery, testing, and sign-off without a dedicated support team, and to make sound decisions under time pressure during after-hours production changes and live escalations.Â Demonstrated experience commissioning warehouse execution/control software and associated hardware peripherals.Â Working knowledge of SQL Server-based application environments, including SSDT schema comparison and version control practices.Â Experience with formal software testing methodology (IQ/UAT), including documentation and customer sign-off processes.Â Ability to independently diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve live production issues under time pressure.Â Comfort with hands-on installation work (wiring, hardware configuration) for pick-to-light and overhead illumination systems, or willingness/ability to develop this competency.Â Willingness to work after hours and participate in an on-call rotation.Â Ability to translate business requirements documentation and customer conversations into structured system configuration (settings, network, and parameter specifications).Â Strong customer-facing communication skills; comfortable coordinating directly with customer stakeholders during upgrades, go-live support, and system/interface training.Â Preferred QualificationsÂ Prior experience with AutoStore and/or T-sort systems.Â Experience with ERP/WMS integration testing (e.g., SAP).Â Background in material handling, warehouse automation, or industrial controls environments.Â What we Offer: Medical Insurance Dental Insurance Vision Insurance Health Care Concierge Service 401(k) Retirement Plan (Pre-tax Roth) Company paid Basic Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability Long-Term Disability Voluntary Life AD D Insurance Voluntary Accident, Critical Illness Hospital Indemnity Insurance Pet Insurance Milk Stork Program Wellness Program with gift card redemption and wellness challenges Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick 10 Holidays) Training Development Why KPI Solutions? At KPI Solutions, youâll be part of a team that values innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement. This is more than a reporting roleâitâs an opportunity to make a measurable impact on project success and business performance. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Marketing Operations - Europe
jobs.desc: div class= content-intro h2 data-pm-slice= 1 1 [] About Crunchyroll /h2 p Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love. /p p Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime! /p /div h2 strong About the Role /strong /h2 p The Manager, Regional Marketing Operations is responsible for turning global and regional marketing priorities into coordinated, localized, production-ready, and successfully delivered marketing activity across the Region. /p p This role owns the regional execution layer of the marketing operating model, connecting Regional Marketing with Crunchyroll’s global operational capabilities. The candidate will ensure campaigns are operationally planned, assets are produced and localized to regional requirements, dependencies are managed, and final materials are delivered accurately and on time across relevant regional channels and partners. /p p A critical responsibility of the role is the end-to-end management of marketing localization for the Region. This includes localization of all marketing assets used regionally, whether those assets originate from a global campaign or are created specifically for a regional initiative. The Manager coordinates translation, transcreation, adaptation, versioning, approvals, quality checks, and delivery of localized marketing materials, working closely with Global Localization while remaining accountable for regional marketing localization readiness. /p p The role operates as the regional counterpart to Global Operations, Content and Marketing and Distribution Operations, Content and Marketing, with particularly close interfaces to Integrated Planning, Campaign Operations, Marketing Production, and Marketing Delivery. The objective is to leverage common global processes, technology, production capabilities, and standards while ensuring regional priorities, language requirements, cultural considerations, channels, and market-specific needs are fully represented /p h2 strong Key Responsibilities /strong /h2 ul li Regional Marketing Operations amp; Execution: Own the operational coordination of the Region’s marketing activity, translating global and regional marketing strategies into executable plans, milestones, asset requirements, localization needs, dependencies, and delivery schedules. Maintain an integrated view of regional marketing readiness and ensure activities move effectively from planning through execution. /li li Regional Integrated Planning: Partner closely with Integrated Planning to incorporate regional priorities, launches, campaigns, tentpoles, local initiatives, and market requirements into the broader global marketing planning process. Translate global plans into actionable regional timelines while providing early visibility into local requirements, resource constraints, localization lead times, and execution risks. /li li End-to-End Marketing Localization Management: Manage the localization workflow for all global and regional marketing assets required by the Region, including copy, key art, trailers, video, social assets, paid-media creative, CRM materials, partner assets, promotional content, and other campaign deliverables. Coordinate translation, transcreation, cultural adaptation, versioning, review, approvals, QA, and final delivery, ensuring localized assets are accurate, brand-appropriate, culturally relevant, and available against campaign deadlines. Partner with Global Localization on standards, technology, vendors, workflows, terminology, and quality frameworks while retaining operational accountability for regional marketing localization. /li li Marketing Production Coordination: Partner with Marketing Production to communicate regional production and localization requirements early, define necessary versions and formats, and ensure global source assets are structured to enable efficient regional adaptation. Coordinate requests for region-specific materials where global assets do not meet local needs while avoiding unnecessary duplication of global production capabilities. For regionally originated campaigns, manage the operational interface between regional creative requirements and the appropriate production resources. /li li Marketing Delivery Coordination: Work closely with Marketing Delivery within Distribution Operations, Content and Marketing to ensure final global and localized marketing assets are packaged, distributed, and made available to the correct regional destinations on time. Coordinate region-specific channel requirements, specifications, deadlines, and partner needs and provide clear escalation when assets are missing, incorrect, delayed, or unable to meet delivery requirements. /li li Regional Stakeholder amp; Market Coordination: Partner with Regional Marketing, Content, Social, CRM, Paid Media, Partnerships, Brand, PR, and other local stakeholders to consolidate operational requirements and create one coordinated regional view of campaign execution. Ensure stakeholders have clear visibility into asset availability, localization status, production milestones, delivery readiness, risks, and decisions required. /li li Regional Campaign amp; Asset Readiness: Establish clear readiness checkpoints for priority campaigns and launches, validating that required source assets, localized versions, formats, approvals, metadata, specifications, and delivery destinations are complete. Identify risks early and coordinate resolution across Campaign Operations, Marketing Production, Global Localization, Marketing Delivery, and regional teams before they impact campaign activation. /li li Regional and Partner-Specific Requirements: Own the operational coordination of marketing requirements unique to the Region, including local platforms, commercial partners, media channels, regulatory considerations, language requirements, cultural adaptations, and market-specific formats. Ensure these requirements are communicated sufficiently early to global teams to allow them to be incorporated efficiently into production and delivery workflows. /li li Operational Issue amp; Escalation Management: Serve as the regional operational control point when marketing assets, localization, production, or delivery issues threaten campaign execution. jobs.desc: About Moneybox At Moneybox, our mission is to give everyone the means to get more out of life. We're guided by our belief that wealth isn't about the money, it's about the means to more - more freedom, opportunities, possibilities, and peace of mind. Moneybox is an award-winning wealth management platform, helping over one and a half million people build wealth throughout their lives, whether they’re saving and investing, buying their first home, or planning for retirement. Job Brief We are looking for a Senior QA engineer to join our team, who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment. You will be working with a high calibre team to continuously develop new products/features. What you'll do This is a hands-on role and as a senior member of the QA team, you’ll help ensure the quality of Moneybox products, reporting into the Senior QA lead. Seamlessly deliver numerous large and complex projects, acting as the sole QA on a squad, managing competing workstreams through effective prioritisation and time management. Foster a "quality is everyone's responsibility" philosophy, influencing team members to prioritise risk-based testing over traditional ticket testing. Collaborate with stakeholders and Compliance to define testing and release strategies that effectively balance risk, speed, and quality. Run engaging, cross-functional team meetings (e.g. amigos, go/no-go, incidents) that promote positive outcomes through effective coordination and issue prioritisation. Advocate for the use of AI tools and agents throughout the testing lifecycle, driving efficiency while layering in human critical thinking to validate outcomes. Assess features for test automation suitability, collaborating with engineers on various test types and working with the Automation team to build and promote stable end-to-end automation. Be a visible leader and role model within the QA team, mentoring/coaching others and actively supporting departmental operations to promote learning and innovation across the function. Represent Moneybox externally in the tech community, bringing fresh new ideas back to the team. Who you are You're enthusiastic about working in a fast-growing Fintech and dedicated to making a positive impact on personal wealth, with an interest in technology, AI and QA developments. You possess an excellent understanding of testing techniques and can effectively coach and mentor your team on their application. You're comfortable in multi-disciplinary teams, working closely with developers, and demonstrate effective analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills. You have proven experience in designing and implementing comprehensive test plans and contributing to automation frameworks for complex cross-functional projects. You exhibit effective organisational skills, meticulous attention to detail, and a pragmatic approach to bug reporting, understanding risk, impact, and dependencies. Experience & Skills 5+ years of broad QA experience, with a number of years in a Senior/Lead QA role, including a proven track record of fast-paced delivery. Extensive backend testing skills and understanding of how to test complex logic, APIs, databases, migrations and 3rd party integrations, ideally related to payments or transactions. Deep understanding of testing Mobile apps and Web technologies and the intricacies of each platform. Broad experience with various automated testing techniques and a solid background in test data design and implementation strategies. Demonstrated experience leveraging existing AI tools to promote testing efficiency. Demonstrated ability to work effectively with senior leadership to build good relationships and foster quality as everyone’s responsibility. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior Coaching & Advice Service Manager - (Remote)
jobs.desc: About Moneybox: At Moneybox, our mission is to give everyone the means to get more out of life. We’re guided by our belief that wealth isn’t about the money, it’s about the means to more: more freedom, opportunities, possibilities, and peace of mind. Moneybox is an award-winning wealth management platform, helping nearly two million people build wealth throughout their lives, whether they're saving and investing, buying their first home, or planning for retirement. And now Moneybox is building the means to help more people in more ways - through personal financial advice. We believe that great advice should be available to everyone, at every stage of life, and that technology can help us deliver it with the care, clarity and accountability people deserve. We're building a new kind of advice service from the ground up, and the people who join us now will help shape how millions of people plan for their future. The Senior Coaching Advice Service Manager leads Moneybox's team of Financial Coaches and Advice Coaches — the shared service that gives customers a human relationship alongside our digital capability, whether they're being coached through a non-advised decision or guided through our regulated advice journey. This is a deliberately shared service. Coaches provide non-advised coaching to customers on behalf of Digital Moneybox Limited, segmented by conversation complexity and qualification level; Advice Coaches support customers through our regulated advice journey, and can flex into coaching activity based on capacity. You'll own the team, its competence and quality standards, and how technology — including video calls and AI — supports every customer conversation, before, during and after the call. You will report directly to the Director of Advice, working closely with the Senior Financial Advisers and the Head of Proposition across the wider Advice leadership team. What you'll be doing You'll lead and grow the Coaches and Advice Coaches team end-to-end — from day-to-day people leadership and competence, through to the technology and processes that shape the customer experience they deliver. Team leadership competence Line manage the Coaches and Advice Coaches team, providing day-to-day leadership, coaching and support to a growing group of customer-facing colleagues. Build and own the T C scheme for the Coaches and Advice Coaches team — training standards, sign-off criteria and record-keeping — working in partnership with the Director of Advice, who holds overall T C oversight, so every Coach and Advice Coach is signed off for the conversations they're qualified to have. Design and build out development pathways and onboarding plans as the team scales, giving new joiners a fast, confident ramp and existing team members a clear route to progress. Manage performance against KPIs, coaching individuals and the team as a whole to consistently strong outcomes. Support team development plans and career conversations, including the natural progression from Financial Coach through Advice Coach towards a Financial Adviser pathway. Customer outcomes quality Own service quality across both the coaching and advice-service experience — the standards the team is held to, and how consistently they're delivered. Ensure the team delivers good customer outcomes consistent with Consumer Duty, across both non-advised coaching and advice-service support. Monitor and report against agreed SLAs and customer satisfaction scores (CSAT), identifying trends early and acting on them. Feed insight from customer interactions back to the wider Moneybox team — Product, Risk Compliance, Investment and the Advice leadership team — to drive continuous improvement. Growing the team Own recruitment for the Coaches and Advice Coaches team, building the pipeline and capability needed as Moneybox's coaching and advice services scale. Build out the Adviser Coach Academy — a structured development and progression route from Coach to Advice Coach to Financial Adviser — so a growing share of our future Adviser recruits are homegrown from our own coaching pool. Forecast and plan headcount and segmentation — by qualification level and conversation complexity — against demand. Optimising the experience with technology Own the end-to-end customer experience delivered by the team, and evolve it using technology — including video calls, Intercom and AI — to support customers before, during and after their conversations. Identify where AI and automation can improve pre-call preparation, on-call support (e.g. real-time prompts, next-best-action) and post-call follow-up, working with Product and Technology to implement them. Test and iterate new tools and ways of working, sharing what works — and what doesn't — with the wider team. What we're looking for Essential Proven experience leading a customer-facing team in financial services or a similarly regulated environment. Track record of managing to KPIs, SLAs and customer satisfaction metrics, with a data-driven approach to improving them. Experience building training, competence and development frameworks for a growing team, including onboarding. Experience recruiting and scaling a team, including workforce planning and segmentation by skill level. Comfortable using technology — including video calling, CRM and AI tools — to improve customer experience, and confident identifying where new tools should be introduced. Level 3 certificate in Financial Services (or equivalent), or RO1 RO4, with a genuine commitment to working towards a Level 4 qualification if not already attained. Strong understanding of Consumer Duty and a genuine instinct for good customer outcomes. Desirable Level 4 qualification in Financial Planning (or equivalent) already attained. Experience operating in a digital-first advice or coaching model. Experience partnering with Product or Technology teams to design AI-supported customer journeys. Background working alongside, or within, a regulated advice team (Financial Advisers, Paraplanners). How you'll work Team leadership, coaching huddles, T C reviews and cross-functional work with the wider Advice team. Expect a regular cadence of 1:1s, coaching huddles and QA reviews with your team, alongside cross-functional work with Product and Technology on the tools that shape the customer experience.
